description: This file defines a Cryptographer class used for symmetric encryption and decryption within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It utilizes phpseclib3 library classes AES and Rijndael to perform cryptographic operations, including key generation, encryption, and decryption, based on a provided symmetric key.

classes.name: Cryptographer
classes.description: A utility class providing methods to encrypt and decrypt strings using symmetric key encryption algorithms, specifically Rijndael and AES, with customizable key and mode settings.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Cryptographer with a specified key.

methods.name: encrypt
methods.description: Encrypts a given string using Rijndael encryption and returns a hexadecimal string.

methods.name: decrypt
methods.description: Decrypts a previously encrypted string back to its original form.

methods.name: generateKey
methods.description: Generates a fixed-length key by XOR-ing the provided key across a 16-byte buffer.
